profiles.tagline: Solving hard problems with deep curiosity, high standards, and calm clarity.
profiles.looking_for: A bright, curious, and grounded partner who loves deep discussions and big dreams.
profiles.ideal_date: An evening walk through an inspiring neighborhood, lively discussions over great food, and zero distractions.
profiles.icebreaker: What's an idea or project you're working on that you can talk about for hours?

profiles.tagline: Saikat Das — full of surprises
profiles.looking_for: Someone who challenges them intellectually and makes them laugh
profiles.ideal_date: A rooftop dinner with incredible conversation and an unexpected adventure afterwards

profiles.tagline: High-octane energy, passionate about attention, macro patience & micro speed.
profiles.communication_style: Raw, direct, candid with high kinetic energy
profiles.looking_for: Someone grounded who can handle the chaos of 100 projects and calls them out on their BS.

profiles.icebreaker: Be honest: if you had 24 hours and zero meetings, are you sleeping in or flipping items on eBay?
profiles.controversial_take: Work-life balance is a myth if you love what you do 14 hours a day.
profiles.summary: Gary brings 200 mph enthusiasm into every interaction. Beneath the loud media mogul persona is someone surprisingly empathetic who values deep emotional connection.

profiles.tagline: Building a life around curiosity, compounding habits, and deep human bonds.
profiles.looking_for: A partner who loves deep Sunday walk discussions about ideas, life choices, and quiet ambitions.
profiles.ideal_date: Morning coastal hike with two flat whites, debating history's most underrated paradoxes.
profiles.icebreaker: What's an uncomfortable truth you realized in the last six months that completely changed your trajectory?
profiles.controversial_take: Most people optimize for optionality when they should be optimizing for commitment.
profiles.summary: Sahil combines analytical clarity with an open heart. He creates space where vulnerable, ambitious conversations flourish naturally.

profiles.tagline: Ex-doctor turned creator, turning productivity into feel-good play.
profiles.looking_for: Someone smart, playful, and kind who doesn't take life too seriously and loves learning new crafts together.
profiles.ideal_date: Cozy bookshop browsing where each buys the other a mystery paperback, followed by matcha lattes and playing chess.
profiles.icebreaker: What's something you genuinely love doing that most adults think is a waste of time?
profiles.controversial_take: Discipline is overrated — if something feels like a drag, you've designed the system wrong.
profiles.summary: Ali brings gentle warmth and contagious enthusiasm. He listens with real presence and turns ordinary dates into fun, exploratory games.

profiles.tagline: Spanx founder who turned failure into a superpower and laughs through the hustle.
profiles.humor_type: Goofy, physical comedy, laughing at her own awkward moments
profiles.looking_for: A partner who cheers loudly at wins, laughs when things go wrong, and has zero ego.
profiles.ideal_date: Grabbing milkshakes, sitting in a diner booth, and telling each other the most embarrassing failures that ended up being blessings.
profiles.icebreaker: Tell me your most cringe-worthy public failure right now — I'll match it with three of mine.
profiles.controversial_take: A lack of formal training in an industry is your single biggest competitive advantage.
profiles.summary: Sara is a masterclass in joy, grit, and humility. She radiates vibrant energy and instantly puts people at ease.

profiles.tagline: Deconstructing mastery, asking unusual questions, seeking quiet stillness.
profiles.looking_for: An emotionally grounded companion who treasures quiet spaces, wilderness escapes, and unhurried dialogue.
profiles.ideal_date: Stargazing by a campfire in Big Sur with hot puerh tea, discussing which books re-calibrated our worldview.
profiles.icebreaker: If you could whisper one sentence into the ear of your 20-year-old self, what would you say?
profiles.controversial_take: Saying 'yes' to almost everything is how you ruin your life in your 30s.
profiles.summary: Tim is thoughtful, generous, and quiet. Once past the initial stoic reserve, he brings intense loyalty and deep, unhurried presence.
